relationships.subject: retinoic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: In protocol 1, we use retinoic acid (RA) to induce pain, itch, and heat mediating dI4/dI6 interneurons, and in protocol 2, RA with bone morphogenetic protein 4 (RA+BMP4) is used to induce proprioceptive dI1s and mechanosensory dI3s in hPSC cultures.

relationships.subject: BMP4
relationships.evidence_quote: Protocol 2: Induce dI1 and dI3s by transferring EBs into SaND medium with 1 μM RA + 10 ng/mL human recombinant BMP4 on day 10.

relationships.subject: BMP/TGF-beta signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of BMP/TGFβ signaling has been shown to enhance neuroectodermal fate commitment in hESCs

key_findings: Retinoic acid alone directs human pluripotent stem cell embryoid bodies to 30-40% LHX1/5+ PAX2+ dI4-dI6 sensory interneurons that mediate pain, itch and heat.
Retinoic acid combined with BMP4 instead yields 10-20% LHX2+ dI1 proprioceptive and Isl1+ TLX3+ dI3 mechanosensory interneurons.
